text:
maria: Hey @eng — opened PR #4923 that touches runtime/lib/common and telemetry/schema. CODEOWNERS shows eng-runtime for runtime/* and telemetry-team for telemetry/* but this is a cross-cutting tiny change (1 file). Who can approve this? Need it merged before tomorrow's deploy window. https://git.redwood/pr/4923

sanjay: I can review the runtime side but I'm oncall til 6pm. If we need merge earlier, is there an approval proxy we can use?

liam: Is this the file? ```runtime/lib/common/codec.go``` If so I think runtime team owns it, but the CODEOWNERS glob overlaps because of a generated telemetry import. We should either tweak CODEOWNERS or ask for a proxy. @tara do you want to take runtime sign-off?

tara: I can do a quick skim and approve if it's actually tiny. Can you paste the diff or just the hunk? Also please add a short note in the PR explaining cross-team ownership.

maria: Diff snippet: ```diff +1 -1
- import ( "x/unused")
+ // removed unused import 
``` Very small — just removing an unused import and cleaning an import grouping. No behavior change. @sanjay feel free to skip if you're busy.

codeowners-bot: match results:
- /runtime/lib/* -> eng-runtime
- /telemetry/* -> telemetry-team
No explicit rule for runtime/lib/common (falls to eng-runtime).

sanjay: If tara can approve, go for it. Also: agree with adding a CODEOWNERS entry for runtime/lib/common to avoid ambiguity next time.

liam: Agreed. I can follow up with a tiny PR to add a specific CODEOWNERS entry after this merges. For now @tara please approve and @maria merge once CI is green. :thumbsup: 

tara: :+1: reviewing now.

tara: Left one nit (formatting) but no functional concerns. approving. :white_check_mark: 

maria: Thanks y'all — merging once CI finishes. I'll open the CODEOWNERS cleanup PR and link it here.
